title: 1. Signals and Attention
description: How material events become visible, receive attention and enter organisational response.

title: 2. Organisational Context
description: The purpose, conditions and constraints that make signals, knowledge and decisions meaningful.

title: 3. Knowledge and Expertise
description: How knowledge across people, practices, relationships and records becomes available when it matters.

title: 4. Decision and Authority
description: How organisations form legitimate commitments, establish decision rights and remain accountable.

title: 5. Coordination and Collective Action
description: How authorised decisions become coherent work across teams, systems, partners and AI.

title: 6. Execution and Operational Reliability
description: How authorised work is performed reliably, including exceptions, recovery and operational control.

title: 7. Outcomes, Feedback and Evaluation
description: How to distinguish activity and outputs from outcomes and produce credible evaluative feedback.

title: 8. Organisational Memory, Reflection and Learning
description: How experience is preserved, reconstructed and interpreted to change future understanding and response.

title: 9. Capability Development and Adaptation
description: How learning becomes durable organisational capability and how that capability changes with conditions.

title: 10. Integrated and Responsible Organisational Intelligence
description: The integrated definition, proposed mechanism, responsible exercise and limits of the whole model.

title: Diagnostic and indicator index
description: Research evidence roles, failure classes and quality families. These are not a validated score or front-line checklist.

title: Glossary
description: Core and extended terminology, with distinctions between established constructs and OIBOK working terms.

title: Release 1.0 reader index
description: The original reading path, component versions and source boundary of the release.

title: Open questions and limitations
description: The unresolved conceptual, empirical and practical questions retained in the released body of knowledge.

title: Propositions and evidence
description: Registered propositions, evidence status and research needed to test or qualify the synthesis.

title: Release 1.0 completion record
description: The governing record for the 15 August 2026 release, including permitted claims and retained limitations.

title: Cross-chapter traceability
description: How chapters, capabilities, stages and transitions relate within the released working model.

title: Source and register consistency record
description: Checks of internal consistency and traceability. These checks do not establish empirical validity.

title: Practical toolkit guide
description: Choose a starting point, prepare the evidence and understand the chapter map, examples and reuse terms.

title: Organisational Intelligence Practice Review
description: Investigate one recurring decision or workflow, including its knowledge, authority and coordination.

title: AI Opportunity and Work Design Canvas
description: Compare options and design a bounded intervention, including context, controls, roles and pilot conditions.

title: Outcome and Learning Record
description: Plan evaluation before a change, review effects and assign changes to working practice.

title: Body of knowledge
description: Ten connected chapters on how organisations orient, coordinate and improve.

title: Research and evidence
description: Inspect the evidence, trace the claims and explore the questions that remain open.

title: Practical tools
description: Investigate a workflow, design a change and learn from its effects.
